name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted comment system for blogs and websites with an embeddable widget, admin dashboard and SQLite storage.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD. This admin account is re-applied on every start, so set ADMIN_EMAIL to your real address before the first start (changing it later adds a second admin). Add the URL of each website that embeds the widget as a site in the dashboard (or ATK_SITE_URL) so its requests are accepted.
